notes.title: Cyber Seraph is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
My retro, boss-focused, vertically-scrolling shmup is now available on Steam, hope you all have fun! Make sure you check out the free soundtrack, as well! Controller is supported and new missions will be released for free in the future. 

The alien invaders have launched their final offensive on an already crippled Terra. Only one brave pilot can turn the tide of war. Cyber Seraph is a boss focused vertical shoot 'em up with unlockable abilities.

Cyber Seraph is a vertically scrolling shoot 'em up where you will be facing diverse bosses on your quest to save your homeworld from annihilation. Collect chips from wounded bosses to unlock special abilities and push onward to final victory.

Features
15 menacing bosses to take down (more to be released later)
Pixel art graphics
8 unlockable abilities, with 24 possible upgrades
Adrenaline pumping, nostalgia rich music (soundtrack can be downloaded / listened to on Steam)
Full controller support
Achievements
Demo

notes.title: Game release announcement + free demo available NOW
notes.notes:
Hey all! My shmup Cyber Seraph is releasing on 17.07, so that's very soon. The game will have 15 achievements for all 15 bosses. More bosses will be released in the future including some non-boss missions.

Right now you can get the free demo from the store's pages for free. It has 3 bosses (2 story bosses and 1 bonus boss), and 3 achievements, so be sure to hunt for them! =)

Take care!
